project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo with Cloudflare Workers edge and React frontend (Vite)
build_system: pip-compile with requirements.in/requirements.txt, Docker for deployment
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py fixtures, TestClient (sync) and httpx AsyncClient, unittest.mock for MongoDB/service mocks
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt in apps/backend. 2. Run pytest tests/ from apps/backend. 3. Optionally docker build apps/backend to validate container.
setup_instructions: 1. pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt. 2. Set JWT_SECRET env var (min 32 chars). 3. Optionally run docker-compose up for MongoDB/Redis.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Can install packages, pull images. Jinja2 needs to be added to requirements.in.
contribution_requirements: Register new routers in main.py. Use existing admin auth pattern (_validate_admin_session). Follow Beanie ODM patterns from user.py. Use existing AzureSearchService client pattern.
key_patterns: Models use Beanie Document with Settings class for collection/indexes. Services are singletons. API routes use APIRouter. Admin endpoints use cookie-based auth with _validate_admin_session. Config via pydantic_settings with Optional fields. init_beanie called in db/mongo.py with document_models list.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ has: api/v1/ (routers), core/ (security, rate-limiting), db/ (mongo.py, redis.py), models/ (Beanie docs), services/ (ai/, comms/, payment/, search/). Tests in apps/backend/tests/. Docker in apps/backend/Dockerfile.
